name: Choice Mega-Chews | 200mg Gummies 2pk | Strawnana for Scale
description: Looking for a gummy bursting with flavor and feels? Look no further, Choice Chew's Strawnana Smoothie has what you're looking for. We took the irresistible flavor of a ripe banana and the bright flavor of fresh strawberries and smashed them together into one delicious smoothie flavored gummy. Made from scratch and infused with premium, high potency distillate, it's no wonder Choice Chew's are a Michigan favorite!
